messages:
sam: Quick cross-team check — where do we stand on token-cost attribution schema + latency breakdown for the billing milestone? Need owners, blockers, and PR links. @priya @mike
priya: We're blocked on the event contract change from product. Waiting on final list of attributes. Filed a WIP PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/142
mike: Can pick up the latency-side mapping after that. My remaining task is adding per-route token_cost tag in event forwarder. PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/148
jordan: FYI the dedupe job is causing ~10s tail lat on ingest during bursts. Eng-Infra is investigating. Might affect accuracy window for attribution.
dana: Product clarified we need customer_tier and model_variant in events. Priya — can you confirm field names? Prefer snake_case.
sam: @priya can you post the minimal JSON sample we expect? helps us align.
priya: sample below:
```
{
  "event": "token_attribution",
  "customer_id": "acct_123",
  "customer_tier": "enterprise",
  "model_variant": "redwood-v2-quant",
  "route": "/generate",
  "tokens": 124,
  "latency_ms": 85,
  "token_cost_usd": 0.0037
}
```
mike: noted. I'll map token_cost_usd -> usage.cost_usd in the billing sink. One question: are we also sending raw_token_count vs billed_tokens? need both for accuracy.
priya: send both. raw_token_count and billed_token_count. Billed can be computed later but keep source data.
jordan: infra update — investigating dedupe job (kinesis consumer) scaling config. ETA 2h for mitigation (increase shards temporary).
dana: For owners: Priya = schema lead, Mike = billing mapper, Jordan = infra mitigation, Sam = rollout plan + dashboard. Is everyone ok?
mike: ok from billing side. will open follow-up PR to add billed/raw fields and unit tests.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for telemetry-forwarder v1.9.3 to prod-us-east-1
eng-bot: CI results for https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/148: 11/12 passing, flaky test telemetry::ingest::dedupe_test failing. Investigating.
sam: let's reconvene 10:30 PT if infra takes longer. Otherwise async pings here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
mike: ack, will ping when PR is ready.
